equipment_type: Water-cooled variable-speed screw chiller / heat pump (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YVWA water-cooled variable-speed screw chillers (one or two compressors, chiller or heat pump mode) fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: YVWA chillers connect to a BAS through the SC-EQ communication card on BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can start/stop the unit, write the chilled liquid setpoint, current limit and heating setpoint, and switch between chiller and heat pump mode. Read-only points cover chilled and condenser liquid temperatures, per-system pressures, % FLA, hours and starts, VSD values, valve positions and multistate operational and fault codes per system.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1, AV 2, AV 4, BV 1, BV 3, BV 4) is treated as commandable; everything else as read-only.

System 2 points only report on two-compressor units. MV 2 / AV 502 are printed twice: Sys 1 fault code on two-compressor units and the unit fault code on one-compressor units, each with its own code table; they are merged here and both tables are given.
Operational and fault code MVs are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say; the AV copies (AV 501-504) carry the raw code. Binary states are as printed.
This list has no MV 65001 Units object. Units shown are the IP units.
Spare and reserved objects are left out.

integration.summary: Put the chiller in remote control (BV 20 reads Remote), then start/stop it with BV 1 and write the chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2); heat pump units also take BV 3 (mode) and AV 4 (heating setpoint). Read BV 5 for chiller run, the leaving chilled liquid temperature, VSD frequency and BV 6 for the chiller alarm; the fault code MVs give the cause.

minimum_points.name: LOCAL REMOTE CONTROL MODE
minimum_points.why: Must read Remote (1) for BMS control

minimum_points.name: SYS 1 FAULT CODE / FAULT CODE
minimum_points.why: Fault/inhibit code, Sys 1 or unit (1 = none)

integration.enable: BV 20 shows Local or Remote control mode. The points list gives no point to change it and no write-enable point. On heat pump units BV 3 selects chiller or heat pump operation.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
The fault code table differs between one- and two-compressor units; check the compressor count before decoding MV 2.
